answer: Lantern Ledge Assignment. Each epoch, a public verifiable random beacon assigns every registered agent a random position on a fixed ledge; only agents landing on cells marked with an onyx token may act as validators or open new accounts that epoch. The beacon is unbiasable and unknowable until published, so an attacker cannot precompute which identities to spawn or buy. To guarantee at least one usable identity, a sybil must control enough accounts to cover many random draws, paying registration and upkeep on each idle identity every epoch.
